finite_contact_scope.support_criterion: For this visual architectural model, each solid hip seat must contact the underlying roof and the round ridge over a finite central support band in the actual serialized mesh. Full contact under the entire cap width is not required where the cap intentionally overhangs a narrower tapered seat.
finite_contact_scope.rationale: Root read the actual exported triangle reports and ridge_seat/tube construction: the 45mm-radius round ridge sits on a tapered crest whose width is narrower than the cap. All36hips×7sections×5offsets(-10,-5,0,+5,+10mm),1260 actual tests, have positive solid interval overlap; the reported minima are19.146mm roof-to-seat and21.845mm seat-to-ridge. Thus the existing centerline evidence is strengthened to sampled finite-width support. The400 gaps at±25mm and72 endpoint rays outside the seat/roof footprint remain recorded; they do not imply that the whole ridge floats. Original full-width criterion/result are not altered. Door,porch and open-hoop tests remain separate actual positive evidence.
